name: Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM)
status_detail: Operational · main campus at Serdang since 1971
summary: Public research university at Serdang on the south-eastern edge of the Klang Valley, tracing its roots to a 1931 School of Agriculture and formally established as Universiti Pertanian Malaysia in 1971. It counted 30,720 students in December 2024.

scale.label: Established
scale.value: 29 October 1971; renamed Universiti Putra Malaysia in 1997

why_it_matters: One of the largest single landholders in the south-eastern Klang Valley. UPM's 1,100-hectare Serdang campus anchors an education and research cluster that pulls population and industry toward Serdang, Bangi and the corridor toward Putrajaya.
questions_to_follow: How much of the Serdang landbank gets urbanised as the campus edges build out?
